The measures include a one-off €50 allowance for individuals and households with incomes below the poverty line.
The excise duty on liquefied petroleum gas will be scrapped.
€170 million aid will be made available to farmers, including €100 million in compensation for price differences from 2025.
Agricultural producers will receive fuel aid of nearly €0.44 per litre.
